lines.say: Welcome to Class 27. Body Systems and Locating Parts of the Body.
Rule one. Use location words to say where an organ is.

show.text: Use location words to say where an organ is.
show.bn: কোনো অঙ্গ কোথায় অবস্থিত, তা বোঝাতে অবস্থান নির্দেশক শব্দ ব্যবহার করুন।

lines.say: The heart is in the chest.

show.text: The heart is in the chest.

lines.say: The stomach is below the diaphragm.

lines.say: Notice below.

show.text: The stomach is below the diaphragm.

lines.say: Rule two. Use is or are with the past participle to describe where something is located or what it does.

show.text: Use is or are with the past participle to describe where something is located or what it does.
show.bn: নিয়ম ২: কোনো কিছুর অবস্থান বা কাজ বোঝাতে is অথবা are-এর সঙ্গে past participle ব্যবহার করুন।

lines.say: The heart is located in the chest.

lines.say: Food is digested in the stomach.

lines.say: Notice in.

lines.say: Not: The heart is at the chest. Say: The heart is in the chest.
The heart pumps blood.
